test_title: PYST 69: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the purpose of the Indian AI tool ‘OncoMark’ introduced by Indian researchers in November 2025?

options.text: To maintain nationwide cancer patient data for government health records
To conduct public cancer awareness programmes through digital platforms
To create standard cancer treatment guidelines for hospitals and clinics
To analyse cancer’s molecular hallmarks for personalised diagnosis and therapy

solution:
The correct answer is __**To analyse cancer’s molecular hallmarks for personalised diagnosis and therapy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian AI tool** known as **OncoMark** was introduced by **Indian researchers** and computational biologists in **November 2025** to address the complexities of cancer treatment.
 
• The primary purpose of **OncoMark** is to **analyse cancer’s molecular hallmarks**, which are the biological signatures that drive tumor growth and resistance to treatment. ***Hence, option 4 is correct.***
 
• It utilizes **Machine Learning (ML)** and **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** to interpret vast amounts of **genomic data** and **proteomic profiles** to provide a **personalised diagnosis**.
 
• The tool identifies specific **genetic mutations** and **biomarkers**, allowing doctors to move away from generic treatments toward **personalised therapy** tailored to the individual’s unique cancer profile.
